claims.statement: Tom Allen was to spar the wind-up against Joe Coburn at a sparring exhibition at Mozart Hall on 25 April 1870.
claims.excerpt: between Joe Cobura aud Tom Alien, who appear in ring costume.

notes: Date from 'to-morrow night' (paper dated 1870-04-24). The list of other boxers is garbled; the hint's McCoole and Kelly are not clearly readable here and are not claimed.
